rules.name: DNS Tunneling Detection
rules.description: Detect anomalous DNS query patterns indicating data exfiltration via DNS
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog| where DestinationPort in (53, 5353)| where DeviceAction == "Denied" or DeviceAction == "Blocked"| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 5 // AZ-EXFILTRATION-157

rules.name: Large Data Transfer to Cloud Storage
rules.description: Detect bulk data uploads to S3/Azure Blob/GCS from unusual sources
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog| where SentBytes > 5242880| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 5 // AZ-EXFILTRATION-158
